ops.whyShort: The carapace stack was dropped, so the report turn-in goes too.
ops.original: Skip the Zukk'ash Report turn-in. The carapace stack that opens it was already dropped.

ops.whyShort: March of the Silithid was only a tip. Horde 4494 requires 7732. Questie pre.single is 32 or 7732, and 32 is not a Horde substitute.
ops.original: Drop March of the Silithid and Bungle in the Jungle. Horde 4494 needs Zukk'ash Report, and that report is dropped on this pass.

ops.whyShort: 95472 was dropped because 95321 is not on the route. 95321 needs 95312. The boat is optional travel and is not Consolation Prize.
ops.original: The Steamwheedle boat to Powderfuse Port is optional travel, about a minute, and it is not tied to Consolation Prize.
